sourceRefs: Pantheon supervisor is the only routine implementation dispatcher
Codex and Codex2 may be different accounts and remain distinct configured quota groups
Live rollout must use the governed gate-before-switch path with rollback
Observed live cycles remain approximately 51 to 80 seconds despite configured short polling
Each cycle adds a full interval after serial provider, repository, canonical-state, and evidence work
Queue-to-start latency and lock convoying make auto-workers appear slow even when slots are free
healthy worker leases and resumed process generation are protected
newer task evidence can consume stale missing-process streaks without global threshold weakening

acceptance: Reproduce the live 2026-08-02 cadence evidence: nominal short polling produces roughly 51 to 80 second cycles and delayed queue-to-start because serial cycle work is followed by another full sleep.

Schedule from a monotonic deadline: subtract elapsed cycle work from the target interval, do not add a full interval after slow work, and define deterministic overrun/catch-up behavior that cannot busy-loop.
Keep provider/network, git/GitHub, evidence rendering, and other slow I/O outside runtime-admission, canonical task-state, and activity locks; document and test the global lock order.

Batch logically related runtime and canonical mutations per phase and reuse one authoritative snapshot where safe instead of reloading and journaling per task; preserve fail-closed CAS and audit ordering.
Expose bounded per-phase elapsed time, lock-hold time, cycle elapsed time, cadence overshoot, queue-to-start latency, and batch counts without logging credentials or unbounded task data.

Regression tests use a fake monotonic clock and injected slow phases to prove fixed cadence, overrun behavior, no busy loop, bounded lock holds, batch atomicity, crash recovery, and unchanged dispatch decisions.

Preserve dependency, priority, worker limits, failure-loop/chair triage, task-scoped quota/auth fallback, exact-head review, active leases, explicit Human/Ops reviewer, and existing rollback semantics.
Codex and Codex2 remain separate configured account and quota groups. Do not hardcode account equivalence and do not add a global mutual-review ban.

Use a clean task worktree from current origin/dev, commit only declared scope, run focused and full supervisor plus ai-status regressions, py_compile, JSON, diff and trailer checks, open PR to dev, obtain exact-head Human/Ops review, merge and canonical archive.
No live service restart or deployment belongs to this source task. Rollback is merge revert; live promotion is the dependent governed V8 canary.
task_spec.phase: Supervisor scheduler / fixed cadence / lock and mutation batching V9
task_spec.summary: Remove full-sleep drift and per-task mutation convoys so dispatch cadence tracks its deadline while preserving fail-closed governance.
task_spec.title: Make supervisor cadence deadline-based and batch canonical/runtime mutations

acceptance: Start only after every source dependency is merged, independently exact-head reviewed, canonically archived, and present in the exact dev candidate SHA.
Promote only through the existing transactional gate-before-switch path; do not patch dev-root, directly restart a service, or switch to an unreviewed tree.

Record prior and candidate runtime SHA, config hash, PID/start ticks, command root, provider homes, account/quota groups, task snapshot, queue snapshot, and rollback target without exposing credentials.
Prove Codex and Codex2 remain distinct configured account/quota groups and retain the repository reviewer policy; no same-account assumption or global mutual-review ban is introduced.

With a sanitized isolated fixture or current live evidence, prove an incompatible provider-local models cache is quarantined outside locks, a fresh probe runs once, actual usage-limit output becomes quota_reached with sanitized reset time, and auth.json/key material is untouched.

While Codex is quota-blocked, prove only eligible task-scoped owner/reviewer pairs can atomically fall back to healthy Codex2; dependencies, priority, capacity, cooldown, failure-loop, chair triage, exact-head review and active leases remain unchanged.
Prove stale auth cache readmission, explicit Human/Ops reviewer preservation, healthy governance handoff, and resume PID/starttime/process-generation refresh on the promoted runtime.

Observe at least ten fresh cycles and report median, p95, maximum, cadence overshoot, lock-hold, queue-to-start, duplicate-probe, duplicate-dispatch, and worker-heartbeat evidence; fixed cadence must not busy-loop or add a full sleep after cycle work.

Run negative canaries for revoked auth, quota without reset, timeout, ambiguous cache path, overlapping task artifacts, reused PID, and stale exact-head review; all remain fail closed without consuming unrelated workers.
Automatically roll back on any source, config, lock, lease, queue, provider, reviewer, cadence, or dispatch invariant failure and prove the prior runtime resumes for at least three cycles.
Commit only exact canary/rollback evidence through a clean PR to dev, obtain exact-head Human/Ops review, merge, and canonical archive.
task_spec.phase: Supervisor governed live promotion / integrated V9 canary
task_spec.summary: Transactionally promote the full repair chain and prove fast cadence plus distinct-account quota fallback without weakening governance.
task_spec.title: Promote and prove scheduler, quota fallback, lease, and reviewer invariants
